title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Sokkali Mainor
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Ragasiya Kolaiyaali
desc: A crime expert races against time to help Kerala police catch a serial killer responsible for multiple murders before more victims fall prey.

title: 12th Fail
desc: After a cheating attempt comes to light, Manoj Kumar Sharma, fails his tests. Years later, determined to become a police officer, Manoj attempts one of the most difficult exams in the country.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Theeya Velai Seiyyanum Kumaru
desc: Kumar falls for Sanjana and seeks guidance from Mokia, a love guru, to win her heart. However, things take a dramatic turn when Sanjana turns out to be Mokia's sister.

title: Naan Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

title: Joe
desc: Following heartbreak from his university sweetheart, Joe embraces the concept of an arranged marriage, seeking a fresh beginning.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Vettai
desc: An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.

title: Lucky Baskhar
desc: Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.
